verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦੁ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਆਗਮੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: naaradh munee akhaidhaa aagam jaan na dheeraj aanai|

en.bdb: Even being adept in the Vedas and Shastras Narad, the sage, had no forbearance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਜਲਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sun sun masalat majalasai kar kar chugalee aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: He would listen to the conversations of one assembly and would talk about it in the other.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕਾ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਨਵਿਰਤੀ ਹਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: baal budh sanakaadhikaa baal subhaau naviratee haanai|

en.bdb: Sanaks et al. also always reminded of the child wisdom and because of their restive nature they could never attain contentment and always suffered loss.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਜੈ ਬਿਜੈ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: jai baiku(n)Th karodh kar dhei saraap jai bijai dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: They went to heaven and happened to curse Jay and Vijay, the door-keepers. Ultimately they had to repent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਸੁਕਦੇਉ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: aha(n)meau sukadheau kar garabh vaas haumai hairaanai|

en.bdb: Because of his ego Sukadev also suffered for a long time (twelve years) in the womb of his mother.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਉਲੰਗ ਭਰੈ ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dh sooraj aaula(n)g bharai udhai asat vich aavan jaanai|

en.bdb: Sun and moon also full of blemishes, indulge in the cycle of rising and setting.
Engrossed in maya they are all afflicted by ego.
